verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's own docs describe a secure online client portal where clients upload and review documents with their attorney, communicate in one place, and track case status. That covers the core of the story. Nothing shows the portal surfaces next steps, and the docs give no detail on what the status view contains. Missing for 10: documented next-steps or action-item display in the portal, detail or screenshots of the status dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration of the portal.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product

citations.quote: our secure online portal, where you and your attorney can upload and review documents together, communicate directly in one place instead of scattered emails, and track your case status
